note: Family report card — graded on fun, guts, and steals. Everyone passed with flying colors.

teams.title: The Closer
teams.blurb: Made the first pick in family draft history — Bijan Robinson! — and was still stealing stars at the very end. A.J. Brown with pick 25 is highway robbery.
highlights: 🥇 Bijan Robinson, the first pick ever
😱 A.J. Brown still on the board in round 7

teams.title: The Riverboat Gambler
teams.blurb: Ja'Marr Chase in round 5 and Derrick Henry in round 7 are two of the biggest heists of the day. The round-3 Sam Darnold pick? We don't talk about the Sam Darnold pick.
highlights: 🐴 Derrick Henry gallops in at pick 26
🤫 Sam Darnold, a bold round-3 adventure

teams.title: The All-Star Collector
teams.blurb: Puka, Christian McCaffrey, Jonathan Taylor, and then Justin Jefferson with the second-to-last pick of the draft. This roster looks like a Pro Bowl team.
highlights: 🌟 Four of the top 15 players on one team

teams.title: The Magician
teams.blurb: Grabbed the first quarterback off the board — Josh Allen — then Saquon, Amon-Ra, and Achane kept falling into her hat. Balanced, sparkly, dangerous.

awards.title: Steal of the Draft
awards.text: Ja'Marr Chase — the #3 ranked player — still there at pick 18.

awards.title: Best Last Call
awards.text: Justin Jefferson with the 27th of 28 picks. Unbelievable.

awards.title: First Pick in Family History
awards.text: Bijan Robinson opens the Espinosa FFL record books.

awards.title: Boldest Move
awards.text: First quarterback off the board — Josh Allen never made it out of round 1.
